document.title: Compare two review documents
document.summary: `compare --from` and `--to` diffs two review documents. Matching uses group id, unique title, then hunk overlap. The CLI prints a text report, JSON, or a local UI. Live git stays the how.
document.why: [#72](source:s1) wants a comparison of two review JSON files for the same change, so a human can see how grouping and claims shifted.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 13
sources.gist: Implement an initial usable version of #72. Prefer not to edit SKILL.md. If SKILL.md must change, follow writing-for-agents.

lookFor: [#72](source:s1) forbids a second code-diff view. The compare UI and text report print hunk pointers, not patch text.
[#72](source:s1) keeps forge patch-set IDs out of the product model. Groups match by id, unique title, then hunk overlap.
[#72](source:s1) forbids auto-accept of the later review. `compare` reports. It does not write a review file.
[#72](source:s1) lists speculative drill-down UX as out of scope. This change does not add that UX.
[The session](source:s5) asked to leave `skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md` unchanged unless required. No hunk touches that file.

groups.title: Review comparison
groups.why: [#72](source:s1) needs a comparison of interpretation documents, not of the live git diff.
groups.summary: `compareReviews` matches groups by id, unique title, then hunk overlap, and diffs the interpretation fields.
lookFor: Subtle. A group split matches the overlapping group and lists the rest as added. Empty hunk sets never match by overlap.
When two reviews cite the same source under different ids, equality uses the remapped href. The from-text in the payload stays the original string.

groups.title: Text report
groups.why: The default CLI output needs a readable report of the same payload.
groups.summary: `formatCompare` prints Interpretation, From, To, Document, and Groups from the payload.

groups.title: compare command
groups.summary: The CLI loads two review files, skips the work-tree check, and prints text, JSON, or opens the UI.

groups.title: Compare HTTP server
groups.why: `--open` needs a server that serves the comparison without live git.
groups.summary: `startCompareServer` serves `/api/compare.json` and returns 404 for other `/api/*` routes.
lookFor: Compare mode 404s `/api/review.json` and other live-git routes. The UI does not wait on a missing review payload.

groups.title: Compare UI
groups.why: [#72](source:s1) wants a clear comparison without a second code-diff view.
groups.summary: `Root` fetches `compare.json`. On 200 it mounts `CompareApp`, which shows added, removed, and changed groups as interpretation plus hunk pointers.
lookFor: `fetchCompare` returns null on any non-OK response, so review `serve` still boots when `/api/compare.json` is missing.

groups.title: README command
groups.why: The README still listed only index, validate, serve, and export.

commits.subject: Treat remapped source hrefs as the same claim

When two reviews name the same source under different ids, compare grouping and prose against the match, and keep the original from-text in the report.

commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Show how grouping and claims shifted between two review JSON files. Live git stays the how: this is interpretation only, with no second code-diff view and no auto-accept of the later file.
